title: SensoTrue DM5, Givaudan's bio-based alternative to DM5 silicone in hair care
summary: Givaudan Active Beauty has just unveiled a new bio-based emollient developed through a combination of white biotechnology and green chemistry as an alternative to 5 cSt dimethicone (DM5 silicone). Designed to move with the hair rather than coat it, SensoTrue DM5 enables hair care formulations that deliver a responsive feel and lightweight performance. title: Coty plans to axe 155 of its 200 jobs in France, unions say
summary: The US beauty and fragrance group Coty, whose brands include Marc Jacobs, Calvin Klein, Rimmel and Bourjois, among others, plans to cut 155 of its 200 jobs in France, union representatives told AFP on Friday, 6 November. The company confirmed that it had proposed an overhaul of its operating model in the country. title: Metsä Board upgrades its coated white-top kraftliner production chain
summary: The Finnish packaging board manufacturer has launched a project to modernise the finishing operations at its Kemi mill. Metsä Board will therefore modernize the winder of the factory's cardboard machine. The operations must be implemented during the annual maintenance shutdown scheduled for October-November 2026. title: Pure Trade creates Lancôme's festive The Suite Escape Palette
summary: For the 2026 holiday season, Lancôme entrusted Pure Trade Worldwide with the design and manufacture of the case for The Suite Escape Palette, dressed in a décor created by French artist Octave Marsal. The challenge for Pure Trade's teams was to give depth to this illustration of a Parisian palace hotel, the setting for an impromptu celebration.
